---
title: "Combinatorial Optimization and Constraint Satisfaction"
subtitle: "Modelling and solving with MiniZinc"
---

Constraint satisfaction and optimization models built with MiniZinc, with an emphasis on making the solver efficient.

[View source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/combinatorial-optimization-csp){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## What it covers

- **Constraint modelling**: expressing problems as constraint satisfaction and optimization models.
- **Symmetry breaking**: removing equivalent solutions to shrink the search.
- **Search space pruning**: cutting branches that cannot lead to better solutions.
- **Performance benchmarking**: measuring how modelling choices affect solve time.

## Why it is relevant to quant work

Portfolio construction and allocation are constrained optimization problems. This project shows comfort with formulating and solving them rigorously, and with reasoning about solver performance.

## Tech

MiniZinc.
